verdict.rationale: There is no documented sandbox, simulator, or separate test environment. Only adjacent safeguards are evidenced. You can compute and inspect a motion plan before the arm moves (PlanMotion). Canary testing, rollbacks, and model staging allow safe versioning. Separate organizations, locations, and machines can be created, which implies a way to isolate test machines from production. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or simulated environment, documented isolation of test data from production data, agent-oriented dry-run or sandbox workflows, and independent corroboration.
